gui.guhs.molentje.tandwielen_goed: All cogs point up. Now for some blowing!
gui.guhs.molentje.kussen.komt: A Blub-guh hops over to the blowing cushion!
gui.guhs.molentje.kussen.bezet: A Blub is already blowing on this cushion. Vahoeg!
gui.guhs.molentje.kussen.geen_blub: No Blub nearby... they must be hopping around the mill somewhere.
gui.guhs.molentje.kussen.niet_hier: This cushion only works at the Maanmolentje in Guhdromenland.
gui.guhs.molentje.draait: The sails are turning! The Zandguh is grinding droomzand. Go and see him!
gui.guhs.molentje.stil: The sails have stopped. Again? Turn the cogs and call the Blubs!

gui.guhs.molentje.zandguh.hint.1: And the cogs on the wall! All arrows up, or nothing turns. Click, click, njeg.
gui.guhs.molentje.zandguh.hint.2: Careful: a cog always turns its neighbour along a little. Vahoeg clever, huh.
gui.guhs.molentje.zandguh.droomzand: It's turning! Here, a little bag of freshly ground droomzand. For Snoes' sweetest dream. Sleep tight, vadsje!
gui.guhs.molentje.zandguh.al: You already got your little bag, njeg. Wait until the mill turns again!
gui.guhs.molentje.stukje: A piece of Snoes' dream: the droomzand!
gui.guhs.molentje.cmd.los: Maanmolentje: cogs up, %s Blubs on the cushions.
gui.guhs.molentje.cmd.geen: The Maanmolentje wasn't found (are you in Guhdromenland?).
block.guhs.molen_tandwiel.lore: Click to turn it. All arrows pointing up? Then the mill can grind!
block.guhs.blaaskussentje.lore: Click it at the Maanmolentje: a Blub-guh comes to sit on it and blows bubbles at the sails.
block.guhs.molenwieken.lore: The sails of the Maanmolentje. They only turn when there's enough blowing, njeg.
